description: Credential endpoints with no rate limiting, as AI builders generate them: an Express auth router (POST /register, /login), a RealWorld-spec users router (POST /users/login), and a Next.js App Router login handler (app/api/auth/login/route.ts). Each lets an attacker try passwords as fast as the server answers. VC130 must fire on the Express routes. The Next.js handler is a known gap: VC130 only recognises app/router/server.post(...) route registration, and a file-level check would be blind to the rate limiting Next.js apps often do in middleware.ts.
